identity.name: CornerKick Pro
identity.description: A professional-grade football statistics dashboard focused on corner kick probabilities and betting insights. Designed for the serious punter who needs clarity in the chaos.
anti_patterns: No rounded, soft, friendly UI - this is a tool for war.
No 'Inter' for headings. No gradients on text.

headings.usage: All section titles, card headers, and major metrics. Use uppercase for labels.

body.usage: General text, descriptions, and user inputs.

mono.usage: ALL numeric data, odds, percentages, and timestamps.

grid_system.container: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4 md:p-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto

cards.classes: bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-700/50 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-none md:rounded-sm overflow-hidden relative

buttons.primary: bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 rounded-sm shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(34,197,94,0.3)] transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-slate-600 hover:border-slate-400 text-slate-300 px-6 py-3 rounded-sm uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors
buttons.icon: p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors

inputs.classes: bg-black/40 border border-slate-700 focus:border-green-500 text-green-400 font-mono text-sm p-4 rounded-sm placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-500/50 outline-none transition-all w-full

badges.high_prob: bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase font-bold tracking-wider rounded-sm
badges.live: bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border border-red-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase animate-pulse rounded-sm

visual_enhancers.scanlines: pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 w-full h-full bg-[linear-gradient(to_bottom,rgba(255,255,255,0.03)_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:100%_4px] z-0
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow for key metrics: drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(34,197,94,0.4)]
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'Grid Border' logic: border-r border-b border-slate-800 for table cells to create a spreadsheet feel.

hero_background.desc: Stadium Night Atmosphere - Use as subtle background with heavy overlay

action_accent.desc: Corner Kick Action - Use for 'Prognostics' or 'Insights' cards

media.icons: Use 'Lucide React' for all UI icons. Use 'Phosphor Icons' (if available) for specific sports icons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text labels are Slate-400 or lighter on Slate-900 backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must be high-contrast Green-500 ring.
accessibility.interactive: All buttons must have a minimum target size of 44px.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPERATIVE: Use the '.js' extension for all React files.
IMPERATIVE: Do not use gradients for text. It reduces legibility on data dashboards.
IMPERATIVE: Implement the 'Scanlines' visual enhancer as a global layout wrapper.
IMPERATIVE: For the Telegram Config, use the 'Code Block' input style defined in components.
IMPERATIVE: The 'High Probability' filter (>9 corners) must use the 'high_prob' badge style.
LAYOUT: Use a Sidebar layout for desktop, converting to a Bottom Nav or Hamburger for mobile.
DATA: Display averages in 'JetBrains Mono'. Format: 'Avg: 9.5' (Green if > 9, Slate if < 9).
TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to: Main Filter Button, Telegram Save Button, Game Card Container.
SHADCN: Customize Shadcn components (Card, Button, Input) to match the 'flat, sharp, border-heavy' aesthetic defined here. Remove default rounded-xl radius.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids.
Create depth through layered design elements (z-index) and borders, not shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully - only for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable inside containers.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
